fieldValues.title: 8. Merge authority
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Decision 949ae72d: agent merge rights follow decision mode and door, the same in every governed repo; agents merge only clear or complicated Door 1 or non-normative work (srs-context convention 0ad939b7). Labels: gate:auto-merge and gate:owner-merge in every repo. muDemocracy.org's AGENTS.md uses its own words: MECHANICAL (gate:auto-merge, only while the MECHANICAL role is ratified; it is draft, so no auto-merge), JUDGEMENT (the label epic-256:owner-merge) and OWNER (open an issue only). srs-programme and practice data auto-merge.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Three vocabularies for one rule: mode × door, gate labels, and MECHANICAL / JUDGEMENT / OWNER.
- epic-256:owner-merge belongs to a retired epic but is still in four repos' label sets and in muDemocracy.org's AGENTS.md.
- The srs required checks (validate-all, check-release-drift) did not run on a CLAUDE.md-only PR, so GitHub blocked its merge.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Does a path filter on required checks belong in the process, or only in srs's CI?
fieldValues.next_action: Retire epic-256:owner-merge and the MECHANICAL / JUDGEMENT / OWNER wording (quick win, proposed).
